Were people in the time and place we refer to as "the wild west" as trigger happy as movies show them?

Actually No. The Main problem of the so called "Wild West" was the lack of police. The territories had federal magistrates who would appoint U.S. Marshals to carry out their warrants etc. Most of the so called "Wild West" revolved around mining towns and areas were grazing land for cattle was at a premium. Off times the large ranches grazed their cattle on federal land with out payment. That land was later patented off to Civil war vets, through the homestead act. As the homesteaders attempted to take legal ownership of the land the cattle ranches resisted, which brought them into conflict with the Federal Magistrates who were supposed to enforce federal law.

But don't feel sorry for the poor sod busters, most of them were Civil War Vets who had seen action in the civil war and knew how to take care of them selves. Then there was the final nail in the "Wild West" coffin. The first thing that settlers did when they got anywhere was to build a Church. The Church, was the general all purpose meeting place. Monday through Friday it was the school for the Children, On Saturday it was the county commission meeting hall. and on Sunday it was the Church. Of course the first thing the county commission (even through there really wasn't a county in existence) did was appoint a Sheriff to enforce its will. This Sheriff was paid for by the homesteader through some sort of taxation. The Sheriff could and often did call out his mounted posse. Most of the counties in the west still have mounted possies, (even though they are now largely ceremonial), It was this available man power for law enforcement, along with the will of a quasi governing body that ended the "Wild West." Of course the availability of tax revenues along with Federal money paid for postal roads bridges, and other civic improvements to make life easier for all inhabitants of the so called Wild West. In all the so called Wild West lasted about 15 years, from that period of 1870 to about 1885. With the time period of 1880 to 1885 peaceful enough that most people only carried a rifle or shot gun for predator control or put meat on the table.
